answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. What survives to the anchor is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The whisper holds work receipts rather than names, so the grove of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, burned when the recruit misbehaves.
